rv.q: Space Dogs can feel sometimes like watching two different shows, but the writers manage to balance the family-friendly with the introspective when it comes to the dogs themselves.
This is an enjoyable show performed by two very talented and likeable performers, but it is somewhat protracted, and I’m not sure who their target market is in this current format.
With engaging performances and some clever staging, it's an entertaining piece of theatre.

cn.t: Critics find this energetic two-hander about Laika the space dog showcases the talented performers' skills, though the show itself receives a modest reception with scores hovering in the mid-60s.
